paragraphs.text:
The door is locked. If you want to try the window, go to 7. If 
you want to pick its lock, make a successful Locksmith or Hard 
Mechanical Repair roll. If you want to pry open the window, 
succeed at an STR roll. 
If any roll succeeds, you are in the Harding House (see following).
If you fail, return to 90.
Make a Stealth roll: if you fail, you’ve made a noise, someone 
may have heard you; go to 51. If you succeed, you may scout the 
house. There are four upstairs bedrooms, any of which might be 
Gliere’s. Go to 52. 
(90)
